# BorderColors

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Stores the colors of an element’s four borders.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new BorderColors(color: Color)
new BorderColors(left?: Color, top?: Color, right?: Color, bottom?: Color)
```

## Properties

- [`bottom`](#bottom): Colour of the bottom border, or `undefined` when none is set for that side.
- [`hasAnyColor`](#hasanycolor): Checks if any side has a border color
- [`left`](#left): Colour of the left border, or `undefined` when none is set for that side.
- [`right`](#right): Colour of the right border, or `undefined` when none is set for that side.
- [`top`](#top): Colour of the top border, or `undefined` when none is set for that side.
